reviews.title: “Slim” Tool Removed from Paid Subscription Without Notice!
reviews.text:
I have been using BeautyPlus for approximately seven years, and I am extremely disappointed with the recent changes to this application.

On March 30, 2026, I paid 4,490 RUB for my annual BeautyPlus Pro subscription.

One of the main reasons I have continued paying for this application for years was the Slim tool, previously available in the Portrait section. This essential feature allowed users to make extremely precise manual adjustments to facial and body contours.

Now, this tool has completely disappeared without any explanation. Several other valuable editing features, including eye color adjustments, are also missing.

I find it absolutely unacceptable that developers can remove essential features from a paid application without properly informing their customers, while continuing to charge the full subscription price.

The application now offers significantly fewer editing capabilities than it did when I purchased my subscription. In its current state, I no longer consider it worth the annual subscription fee.

I expect clear and specific answers to the following questions:

1. Why was the Slim tool removed from the Portrait section?
2. Is this removal permanent?
3. Will you restore this essential feature, and if so, when?
4. What refund or compensation options are available to paying subscribers who have lost access to features they specifically paid for?

As a loyal customer of approximately seven years, I find this treatment of paying subscribers extremely disappoi

reviews.title: “Free Trial” Resulted in an Immediate $50 Charge - Deceptive Subscription & Trial Terms
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app hoping to use it for editing short videos. Within a matter of minutes, however, it became clear that it did not offer the capabilities I needed. During the roughly ten minutes the app was installed on my device, I was prompted multiple times to purchase an annual subscription costing nearly $50. I had no intention of committing to an annual subscription at that price, particularly before I had even been able to determine whether the app could meet my needs.

I then discovered that many of the features necessary to properly evaluate the app were inaccessible without a subscription. Ordinarily, I would have simply deleted the app at that point. However, I was offered a one-week free trial, which I accepted for the sole purpose of determining whether the paid features would make the app useful to me.

After only a few minutes of testing, I concluded that they did not. I immediately went to my Apple subscriptions, cancelled the free trial the same day I started it, and prepared to delete the app. At that point, I received a payment-issue notification indicating that a charge of nearly $50 was being attempted.

To be clear: I used this app for approximately ten minutes, enrolled in what was expressly presented as a one-week free trial, and cancelled that trial almost immediately. I did not knowingly authorize an immediate $50 annual subscription, nor did I receive anything remotely resembling a year’s worth of service.

Situations like this are precisely why

It used to work so you could only add a certain degree of the smoother, but now when I try to use it it puts it on max smooth automatically and makes it look so bad and fake. Now the video feature doesn’t allow me to use .5 and the quality is terrible. Very sad since I’ve been paying for this app for years. I won’t be renewing this next year. I did already co tact support but they didn’t help. Also seems like other people have noticed the same thing. Maybe they should look into fixing the things people are complaining about instead of just “acting” clueless about the issues.

reviews.title: Bring it back!!
reviews.text:
****everyone!! I found a WAY better app AND has FREE features WAY BETTER than this app it’s called: Beauty cam****

This honestly was my favorite editing app the only one I even used but now y’all removed the option to watch an ad to unlock the premium features and literally that completely ruined the experience for me. I understand that you need to make money but the ad unlock system was the perfect middle ground. It let all of us who couldn’t afford subscriptions still enjoy and use the app and you still earned ad revenue in return. It was fair and it use loyal users around now it feels like we’ve lost that balance. Not everyone can pay for a premium plan and taking away the ad option just pushes us, hundreds if not thousands or more, away and deleting the app instead of making us want to stay. Pleaseeee reconsider bringing it back. It made BeautyPlus feel accessible and that’s what made it such a good app. I really hope you listen to your users on this one. BeautyPlus has always been amazing I’d love to keep using it but I can’t.
